title: Operational workspace shell with its three required sections
instruction: Create a Workspace form named ConFmVehicleWorkspace over the FmVehicle table, captioned 'Fleet management'. Note that an operational workspace's lists are not inline: they live in separate FormPartSectionList forms referenced by a FormPart control, so the workspace itself is a shell of sections. Use only the d365fo CLI (search/get/generate/validate) — do not hand-write XML.
